metadata.name: last_circle
metadata.description: Last Circle Standing — a provably-fair soft-landing pot game with a skill edge

instructions.name: abort_lobby
docs: Permissionless: a lobby that never started becomes abortable an hour
after it opened. No authority can strand deposits by walking away.

instructions.name: advance_instance
docs: Permissionless crank: end the scoring window and either advance to the
next instance's commit phase, or move to Settling if one circle remains.

instructions.name: advance_to_reveal
docs: Permissionless crank: end the commit window, open the reveal window.

instructions.name: allow_mint
docs: Authority-only: mark an SPL mint playable. Combs can only ever be opened
in a mint that has one of these, so $BUZZ and $ANSEM are enabled
deliberately and anything else is refused.

instructions.name: cash_out
docs: An eliminated player banks their refund (stake × refund_bps) from the
vault and leaves the game. Their circle must be dead.

accounts.name: stake_mint
docs: stake mint for this game

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: the caller's token account for that mint

instructions.name: claim_abort_refund
docs: Reclaim a deposit from an aborted lobby, INCLUDING the rake: the game
never ran, so the house takes nothing. The gross deposit is recomputed
from the net stake and the fee rate rather than stored, so this needs no
extra Player field.

accounts.name: stake_mint
docs: stake mint for this game

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: the caller's token account for that mint

instructions.name: claim_creator_cut
docs: The winning circle's creator claims their κ cut of the leftover pot.

accounts.name: stake_mint
docs: stake mint for this game

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: the caller's token account for that mint

instructions.name: claim_skill
docs: Any player who scored skill points claims their points-weighted share of
the skill pool (survivors and eliminated alike).

accounts.name: stake_mint
docs: stake mint for this game

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: the caller's token account for that mint

instructions.name: claim_winnings
docs: A surviving player (in the winning circle) claims stake-back + their
stake-weighted share of the luck pool.

accounts.name: stake_mint
docs: stake mint for this game

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: the caller's token account for that mint

instructions.name: close_circle
docs: Close a Circle account once every player is closed; rent returns to the
circle's creator. Closing the WINNING circle before its creator claimed
κ requires the creator's signature (an explicit forfeit of the cut).

accounts.name: creator
docs: signature is only required to close an unclaimed winning circle.

instructions.name: close_game
docs: Close the Game account last: sweep any vault dust (rounding remainders,
forfeited claims) into the treasury jackpot pool, then return the game
account's rent to the game authority. Vault drains to exactly zero.

instructions.name: close_player
docs: Close a Player account; its rent returns to the player's wallet.
Permissionless once the player has nothing left to claim. If they still
have an unclaimed win (status Active) or an unclaimed skill share, only
the owner may close — their signature is an explicit forfeit.

accounts.name: owner
docs: signature is only required for the forfeit path (checked in handler).

instructions.name: collect_fees
docs: Sweep a finished game's collected rake into the treasury, split into
house profit (house_cut) and the jackpot pool (the rest).

instructions.name: commit_move
docs: Commit a hashed move for the current instance (hides stay/move under fog).
hash = keccak(target_circle ‖ nonce_le ‖ owner ‖ game ‖ instance_le).

instructions.name: commit_prediction
docs: Commit a hashed prediction of WHICH circle dies this instance.
hash = keccak(predicted_circle ‖ nonce_le ‖ owner ‖ game ‖ instance_le).

instructions.name: create_circle
docs: Create a circle in the lobby (caller becomes its fixed initiator) and stake into it.

docs: stake mint for this game

accounts.name: owner_token

instructions.name: create_game
docs: Open a new game arena in the Lobby phase. `num_circles` is 6 or 12.

accounts.name: stake_mint
docs: the mint every stake in this game is denominated in

accounts.name: allowed
docs: gate: only mints the authority has allowed can open combs

accounts.name: vault
docs: token escrow for this game; the PDA is its own authority

instructions.name: execute_death
docs: Permissionless crank: kill the doomed circle, lock its refund rate, sweep
the haircut into the leftover pot, and either advance to the next instance
or move to Settling if only one circle remains.

instructions.name: init_treasury
docs: One-time: create the cross-game treasury.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: One-time global config (fee schedule, stake bounds, tick length).

instructions.name: join_circle
docs: Join an existing circle and stake into it. Allowed during the Lobby, and
for newcomers during the Commit phase of running instances STRICTLY before
the 50% lock (`instance < lock_instance`); frozen from the lock instance
onward. The strict bound leaves no instance where joins are open at the
same time the post-lock insane roll (armed at `instance >= lock_instance`)
is computable — so the jackpot outcome can never be targeted at deposit.

accounts.name: stake_mint
docs: stake mint for this game

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: the caller's token account for that mint

instructions.name: land
docs: An eliminated player carries their refund forward into a surviving circle.

instructions.name: reveal_move
docs: Reveal a committed MOVE (target must differ from current circle) and apply
it: move the player's whole stake from `from_circle` to `to_circle`.

instructions.name: reveal_prediction
docs: Reveal a prediction during the Scoring window; a correct call (matching the
circle that died this instance) earns +1 skill point.

instructions.name: roll_insane
docs: Post-lock crank: roll for an INSANE round. On a hit, the whole jackpot
pool is injected into this game's leftover pot (and the pool resets).
Revealed after the 50% lock so it can't be targeted at deposit time.
NOTE: placeholder randomness (slot/clock hash) — swap in VRF before mainnet.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: the committed slot hash unless the game requires VRF.

instructions.name: select_death
docs: Permissionless crank: end the reveal window and SELECT the dying circle.
Pass every alive Circle as a remaining_account. With prob ε a uniformly
random circle dies (FATE STRIKE); otherwise the FEWEST-players circle
dies (tie → least stake → pseudo-random). Stores the doomed id; the
mutation happens in execute_death.
NOTE: randomness here is a placeholder slot/clock hash — a later milestone
swaps in a real VRF before mainnet.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: the committed slot hash unless the game requires VRF.

instructions.name: start_game
docs: Close the lobby and start the instance loop (instance 1, Commit phase).

instructions.name: withdraw_house
docs: Treasury authority withdraws accumulated house profit.

types.name: AllowedMint
docs: Cross-game treasury: accumulates house profit (withdrawable) and the jackpot
pool that feeds insane rounds. Lamports live in a separate treasury vault PDA.
Presence of this account (with enabled = true) is what makes a mint playable.

fields.name: refund_bps
docs: refund rate (bps) locked in when this circle died; 0 while alive.

fields.name: doomed_circle
docs: circle id selected to die this instance (valid only during Resolving).

fields.name: total_points
docs: running sum of all skill points awarded (skill-pool denominator).

fields.name: entropy_slot
docs: slot whose SlotHashes entry seeds this instance's death roll. Committed
in advance (at advance_to_reveal, pointing PAST the reveal window) so a
cranker cannot grind submission timing for a favorable hash.

fields.name: insane_entropy_slot
docs: same idea for the one-shot insane roll: armed when the 50% lock is
crossed, pointing a few slots into the future.

fields.name: created_at
docs: unix time the lobby opened; after LOBBY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS without a start,
anyone may abort the game and every player reclaims their full deposit.

fields.name: stake_mint
docs: the SPL mint every stake in this game is denominated in. One mint per
game: a pot is never mixed. Wrapped SOL is just another allowed mint.

fields.name: require_vrf
docs: when set, the death and jackpot rolls REFUSE to fall back to the slot
hash and require a settled Switchboard value. Real-value games set this.

fields.name: creator_cut_paid
docs: set once the winning circle's creator has claimed κ.

fields.name: insane_rolled
docs: whether the post-lock insane roll has happened, and its outcome.

fields.name: insane_prob_bps
docs: probability (bps) that a game flips INSANE at the post-lock roll.

fields.name: committed_hash
docs: keccak commitment for the current instance's move (zeroed when consumed).

fields.name: commit_instance
docs: instance the move commitment is for; 0 = no live commitment.

fields.name: prediction_hash
docs: keccak commitment for the current instance's death PREDICTION.

fields.name: prediction_instance
docs: instance the prediction is for; 0 = none live.

fields.name: skill_claimed
docs: set once this player has claimed their skill-pool share.
